Maintain accurate and complete accounting records in accordance with company policies and applicable Philippine accounting standards and regulations. Process transactions and maintain supporting schedules and documentation in Xero. Monitor assigned accounting activities to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timely recording. Accounts Payable Perform Accounts Payable transactions in Xero, including recording and processing supplier and employee-related payments. Review supporting documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company policies. Prepare BIR Form 2307 and maintain the corresponding withholding tax records and schedules. Prepare monthly payment reports and schedules. Advise suppliers and employees regarding payment processing and remittance details. Conduct an annual review of open Purchase Orders (POs) and coordinate necessary follow-ups and clearing activities. Monitor outstanding payables and support timely settlement of obligations. Perform other Accounts Payable-related activities as required. Billing & Accounts Receivable Perform Billing and Accounts Receivable transactions in Xero. Prepare, print, and send customer invoices and related billing documents. Monitor customer collections and maintain accurate records of receipts and collections. Prepare acknowledgement receipts for customer collections. Update and maintain the Customer Creditable Withholding Tax (CWT) Schedule. Prepare schedules relating to Government Share and ER1-94 requirements for the Department of Energy (DOE), as applicable. Assist in monitoring outstanding receivables and follow up on collection-related matters. Perform other Accounts Receivable and billing-related activities as required. Cash-in-Bank Reconciliation Perform regular Cash-in-Bank (CIB) reconciliations for assigned Philippine entities and bank accounts. Prepare bank-related documentation for outward remittances. Maintain complete and organized bank reconciliation files and supporting documents. Perform other cash and bank-related activities as required. Fixed Assets Accounting Maintain accurate fixed asset records and supporting documentation. Assist in monitoring additions, disposals, transfers, and other fixed asset movements. Ensure appropriate accounting treatment and documentation of fixed asset transactions. Perform other fixed asset-related activities as required. General Ledger Accounting & Financial Reporting Manage and maintain assigned General Ledger (GL) accounts for the Philippine entities. Prepare month-end financial reporting entries, including accruals, deferrals, and other month-end adjustments. Prepare and maintain supporting schedules and reconciliations for assigned GL accounts. Review account balances and investigate unusual or outstanding items. Ensure timely and accurate recording of month-end transactions. Provide supporting documentation and analysis for financial reporting and audit requirements. Assist in the preparation and review of monthly financial reports. Perform other General Ledger and Financial Reporting-related activities as required. Assist in the preparation and maintenance of schedules supporting tax filings and statutory compliance. Support the preparation and monitoring of applicable withholding tax requirements, including BIR Form 2307. Maintain organized tax and regulatory documentation for audit and compliance purposes. Assist in responding to tax, regulatory, and statutory requirements as assigned. Monitor assigned tax and regulatory compliance activities and deadlines. Perform other Philippine tax and regulatory-related tasks as required. Audit & Compliance Support Provide accounting schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents required for internal and external audits.
